dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: High-contrast, sharp pale-buff edges clearly visible along the margins of the folded dark grey flight feathers.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: An irregular, roughly rectangular patch of pale buff/white feathers on the posterior neck.
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: A distinct, linear boundary exists between the dark crown and the pale nape patch, followed by another distinct transition to the dark-centered mantle feathers.

other_distinctive_markers: Extremely broad pale fringes on the mantle, scapulars, and wing coverts creating a heavy scalloped effect; wide pale terminal bands on the rectrices.
